# Test data

`small.1path`, `small.1gbwt` and `small.1khash` contain two source files, 4 paths and 11 syncmeres.
Syncmeres 3–11 are contained in exactly one path, syncmers 1 and 2 on none.

Most unit tests and modified test files were generated by Claude.

## Modified data (generated by Claude)

Manually changed files:
1. Convert to text format with `ONEview file > file.txt`
2. Remove index lines (`#`, `%`, `@`, `+`)
3. Change lines mentioned below.
4. Convert to binary using `ONEview -b -t <path|khash> -o <output> file.txt`

`ONEview` was built with `make ONEview` in `external/syng`.

| File | Modification applied to `small.*` | What is tested |
|---|---|---|
| `small_repeats.1path` | Path 3: `z 3 -7 -8 -9` → `z 3 3 -8 -8` | syncmer present in multiple source files (3), non-unique syncmer (8) |
| `small_unordered.1path` | Path 3: `P 17 2 1` → `P 17 3 1` | Paths not ordered by source file |
| `small_o_without_z.1path` | removed first `z`- line  | `o`-line without `z`-line |
| `small_no_t_lines.1khash` | removed all `t`-, `S`-, `L`-, `C`- and `M`- lines | khash-file without `t`-line |

## Syncmere subsets for `distances`

- `small_subset.tsv` contains syncmeres 3, 5, 7, 8, 9, 10 and 11.
- `small_subset_invalid.tsv` contains ID 12 which is larger than the number of syncmers (11).
